visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a white bikini top, sits in a large bathtub overflowing with white soap bubbles. She smiles and moves the foam with her hands in a bright, modern bathroom with a window view of tall buildings. (2) The scene cuts to the woman now in a white bathrobe, standing in a spacious bathroom showroom featuring a large, grey stone-textured bathtub. She talks and gestures toward the tub. (3) A man with glasses and a black t-shirt appears, holding a bottle of green bath soap labeled 'RELAX' while speaking to the camera. (4) The woman is shown pointing at the rough, grainy surface of the stone bathtub, and then demonstrating how to rinse it with a showerhead. (5) The man and woman are seen together at the end, waving and gesturing toward a social media overlay for 'nai.ton_'.
